item.title: FHFA chief says Trump deployed $200B to slash mortgage rates, claims impact was immediate
item.description: Mortgage rates drop to "five handle" as Trump administration targets housing affordability crisis with aggressive $200 billion bond purchase program.

item.title: Trump unveils retirement plan with up to $1K federal match
item.description: President Trump announced federal matching contributions up to $1,000 for lower-income workers whose employers don't match retirement plans, building on existing SECURE 2.0 Act.

item.title: Bill Gates apologizes to foundation staff over Epstein ties
item.description: Bill Gates admitted it was a "huge mistake" to spend time with Jeffrey Epstein, apologizing to Gates Foundation staff for casting a cloud over its work.

item.title: Trump pledges to make housing affordable while keeping values up
item.description: President Donald Trump promises to make housing affordable for new buyers while protecting existing homeowners' property values during his State of the Union address.

item.title: Jamie Dimon warns of pre-financial crisis parallels, says some people doing ‘dumb things’
item.description: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned that current market conditions mirror 2008 financial crisis buildup, citing high asset prices and risky lending practices.

item.title: Aston Martin to cut up to 20% of its workforce
item.description: Aston Martin announced a plan to cut up to 20% of its workforce as ongoing financial struggles and challenging market conditions affecting the luxury automaker.

item.title: Fanatics Games returns with $2M prize pool as everyday fans get chance to compete against top athletes
item.description: Fanatics Games will return for this year's festival with a $1 million prize, and Tom Brady is set for a rematch against last year's fan champion.

item.title: Life-threatening Listeria risk prompts massive frozen blueberry recall across multiple states
item.description: FDA announces Class 1 recall of 55,000 pounds of frozen blueberries due to potential Listeria contamination that could cause serious health consequences.

item.title: Apple implementing age verification tool to ensure users are 18 and up for some apps
item.description: Apple announced a new age verification tool in Utah and Louisiana, as well as Brazil, Australia and Singapore to ensure users are 18+ before downloading certain apps.

item.title: NVIDIA CEO says artificial intelligence boom is just getting started: 'AI is going to be everywhere'
item.description: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said the artificial intelligence boom is only just beginning, anticipating that AI is "going to be everywhere."
